name: TextVQA: Visual Question Answering on Text in Images
description: TextVQA is a visual question answering benchmark requiring reading and reasoning about text present in images. Containing 45,336 questions over 28,408 images from the Open Images dataset, where answers require optical character recognition (OCR) and reasoning on the identified text.
